title: Activate your XRP account
description: Every new XRP Ledger account needs 1 XRP before the ledger will hold it. In this XRP Mobile walkthrough you'll see where the activation card comes from, what the base reserve actually is, how to find your deposit address on the right network, and what changes the moment the funds land. Not financial advice.
lede: New wallet asking you to activate your account? Nothing is broken. Here is what the XRP Ledger wants, and why.

steps.caption: Your account needs activating
steps.body: A new wallet opens on a card that reads Activate your account. Nothing has gone wrong. Your address already exists on your phone, but the XRP Ledger does not know about it until it holds some XRP.

steps.caption: Why the ledger asks for 1 XRP
steps.body: Every account on the XRP Ledger keeps a base reserve of 1 XRP. It is not a fee, and it does not go to XRP Mobile or to anyone else. The amount stays yours, locked for as long as the account exists on the ledger, and it is released if the account is ever deleted.

shots.alt: Why the ledger asks for 1 XRP

steps.caption: Tap Deposit
steps.body: Tap Deposit on the card. It opens the receive sheet, the same one you use for any incoming payment.

steps.caption: Pick XRP on the XRP Ledger
steps.body: Choose XRP on the XRP Ledger. Only that network can activate the account. XRP wrapped on another chain will not arrive at this address, and can be lost.

shots.alt: Pick XRP on the XRP Ledger

steps.caption: Send at least 1 XRP
steps.body: Copy the address, or let the sender scan the QR code, and send at least 1 XRP from an exchange or another wallet. The first 1 XRP goes to the reserve, so send a little more than that if you want a spendable balance from the start.

steps.caption: Your account is live
steps.body: The transfer usually lands in a few seconds. The activation card disappears, your balance appears, and Buy, Send, Receive and Swap become available.
